versions.content: DRAFT When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineCon- trol (0x31) if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]) and DcmDspRoutineFncSignature is set to ROUTINE_FNC_PROXY the Dcm module shall pass the routineControlOption- Record to the called function and send back the resulting routineStatusRecord via the dataInOut parameter where the currentDataLength denotes the size of the passed rou- tineControlOptionRecord and returned routineStatusRecord.
